phase1.explanation:
🦀 **Closures capture their environment in different ways.**

**Capture modes:**

| Mode | Syntax | What it does |
|------|--------|--------------|
| Immutable | `|| { uses variable }` | Borrow immutably |
| Mutable | `|| { modifies variable }` | Borrow mutably |
| Move | `move || { ... }` | Take ownership |

**Rust-chan says:**
"Closures capture variables from their environment. The compiler chooses the least restrictive capture mode."

**Capture rules:**
| Action | Capture mode |
|--------|--------------|
| Read only | Immutable borrow |
| Modify | Mutable borrow |
| Move | Ownership (with `move`) |
